scope: Read-only comparison of existing execution03 receipts against the accepted historical Dorm5 mixed60_40 selector row; no visibility, scoring or solver rerun.
conclusion: Exact accepted actual-Dorm5 final-row parity. The quoted .989/.773 pair belongs to a different earlier synthetic/masked-scene table, per parent clarification, and is not the accepted actual-Dorm5 mixed row.

equal_historical_and_new_values.space_threshold_difference_note: 4e-18 floating-point evaluation difference, with identical selected result and score.

score_definitions_same.space: Per draw, equally average observable-region area-normalized coverage; then average all 3 optimization draws. Not whole-input surface fraction.
score_definitions_same.raw_object: Per draw, sum importance_j*max_selected_view(q_ij)/sum importance_j; then average all 3 optimization draws. No division by full-pool ceiling in this displayed raw score.
score_definitions_same.ceiling: Average over the 3 draws of importance-weighted max q across all 554 candidates, using the same importance denominator.
score_definitions_same.stop: Space gain below 2% of maximum empty-set singleton spatial gain and object gain below 3% of full-pool raw object ceiling, checked after local exchanges.

original_array_identity_check.method: Loaded existing optimization.npz only, hashing dtype.str + JSON shape + contiguous bytes with the receipt's array_record implementation; compared to all 15 native observation records. No metric/visibility/solver execution.

solver_and_config_differences_not_hidden.historical_solver: GPU float64 backend; deterministic 6 residual-gain starts plus unseeded/full greedy paths; k-wise saved same-objective warm starts; up to six one-swap passes and one top12 pair search; 15-view ceiling,35s budget.
solver_and_config_differences_not_hidden.new_solver: CPU NumPy backend; same deterministic 6 diverse starts and unseeded greedy paths; no frozen warm bank; same bounded 1/2 exchanges,15-view ceiling,35s budget; stops after earliest cardinality meets both marginal conditions.
solver_and_config_differences_not_hidden.no_random_sampling_identity_difference: Actual old/new V,Q,weights,region and importance digests match for every draw; final selection and scores also match exactly. Implementation/path differences did not cause a final-row difference.

do_not_mix_with_other_metrics.note: These primary-draw and holdout metrics use different draw/denominator definitions from 3-draw selector space/raw-object scores; none is the old synthetic/masked table .989/.773 pair.
